templates.title: See a flow run (no setup)
templates.use_case: Click Use, then press Run — a formatted summary appears right away. The fastest way to watch a flow work end to end, with nothing to connect.
templates.description: A built-in sample table flows into a Render-text step that turns the rows into a tidy summary. No accounts, no triggers, no setup — fork it and hit Run to see output immediately. The ideal first flow.

templates.title: Web form → Google Sheet
templates.use_case: Share a link to a contact form and have every response land as a new row in a Google Sheet — like Google Forms, straight into the sheet you pick.
templates.description: A hosted contact form (you get a public link) appends each submission as a row in a Google Sheet. Paste your sheet's URL into the Append step, choose the tab, and you're collecting.

templates.title: Save incoming emails to a Google Sheet
templates.use_case: Keep a tidy log of who emailed you — sender, subject and date — automatically appended to a Google Sheet every few minutes.
templates.description: Checks Gmail every few minutes for new inbox messages and adds each one to a Google Sheet. Narrow the search query to log only what you care about (invoices, enquiries, receipts).

templates.title: Daily Google Sheet summary → Slack
templates.use_case: Post a short daily summary from a Google Sheet to Slack every morning, so the team sees the latest numbers without opening the sheet.
templates.description: Every morning at 09:00, reads a Google Sheet and posts one Slack line per row. Edit the schedule, the sheet and tab, and the line format to taste.

templates.title: New email → Slack message
templates.use_case: Get a Slack message for each new email so your team sees it in chat without watching the inbox.
templates.description: Checks Gmail every few minutes and posts a one-line Slack message (sender + subject) for each new inbox email. Point it at any channel and tighten the search to only what matters.
